{{Top|leg}}
A '''Deep Hunter''' was a member of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who refused to be "civilized" by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]; or, as they put it, "tamed" the Quarren. They blamed the Mon Calamari for the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|arrival]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and fought the occupiers. Deep Hunters preferred to live off the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean's]] bounty, using their tools and skills to survive. They occasionally worked as guides and guards to undersea [[Scout/Legends|explorers]]. Deep Hunters usually wore [[deepsuit]]s, and were armed with a [[Spear gun|speargun]]. They also generally maintained a two-man [[Submarine/Legends|submersible]].
